requirements.name: Spatial descriptions / Avatar Animation Stream Format

cases.case: Establish or accept the animation data channel
cases.what: The client creates a 3gpp-ar-animation data channel when it calls and accepts one created by the remote peer.
Only encoder output of animation units is written to the animation channel; nothing else is sent on it.
The animation data channel is created with the sub-protocol string 3gpp-ar-animation and the client recognises incoming channels by it.

cases.case: Sub-protocol in the dcmap attribute of the SDP
cases.what: The client does not write SDP; the offer and answer come from the WebRTC stack and are passed through SWAP unchanged, with no dcmap attribute written by the client.
The animation data channel is created ordered with no retransmit or lifetime limit, which makes it reliable.
The client never sets a maximum retransmit count or lifetime; the channel is always fully reliable (a code comment marks this as for further study).
Each message carries the encoder output flushed after a single added unit, so it holds units of one animation sample.
